* Story 

Leina Takamiya worked as a free agent. 
Lately she was getting more requests from Hinomine Academy for Girls due to strange events. 
The size and stature of the school had garnered TV coverage in the past. 
It was a famous school. 

But the investigation she was consigned to was of another kind. "Screams in the dead of night." "Reports of a suspicious person." 
Leina decided to infiltrate the school herself to verify the extent of the claims. 

She sneaked right into the perversion of SeiCoM. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE115739.html]DLsite English[/url]]

最近，由于发生了奇怪的事件，日之峰女子学园的委托越来越多。

她直接陷入了SeiCoM的变态之中。
